source.qc_summary: 15/16 source-selected tagged birds passed per-pixel QA at BOTH old and new coordinates in BOTH adjacent calendar months, with at least one cloud/saturation-free common scene per month.

calibrate: Before any moving-versus-stationary ecological benefit, quantify agreement between the published USGS MNDWI and independently reconstructed Landsat8 C2L2 MNDWI at observed bird-month modal-core positions.

fixed_sample.cohort: first 16 lexical source tag IDs with first 500–20,000m adjacent-month relocation, matching source 250m monthly modal core geometry and >=5 Local fixes. Keep all 16 in denominator; only QA-passed tags can enter paired measurement.
fixed_sample.matched_pairs: For each QA-passed tag, exactly TWO observed locations: previous-month modal old core at previous month and next-month modal new core at next month. The unobserved counterfactual old site next month is NOT read or used at this calibration stage.
fixed_sample.source_reference: Median original MNDWI across all eligible Local GPS observations in that bird × calendar-month × frozen modal 250m cell, dropping entire conflicting tag+UTC timestamp sets. >=5 point observations.
fixed_sample.satellite: For that observed modal-core center and month, take median Landsat8 MNDWI across ALL same-month scenes with footprint old+new, scene cloud <=80%, QA_PIXEL bits 0–5 clear and QA_RADSAT bits 2,5,11 unset AT BOTH old and new source-defined core positions.
fixed_sample.bands: Landsat-8 green/B3 and SWIR1/B6 Level-2 Collection 2 surface reflectance (STAC green, swir16); apply SR = DN × 0.0000275 − 0.2. Raw DN valid range 7273–43636 inclusive, fill=0.
fixed_sample.formula: MNDWI=(green_reflectance−swir1_reflectance)/(green_reflectance+swir1_reflectance); if denominator <=0.05, nonfinite or result outside [−1,1], mark scene not valid. No clipping to rescue.
fixed_sample.sample_grain: One source MNDWI median and one reconstructed Landsat8 monthly median per tagged bird × calendar month × observed modal core; 2 tagged-month observations per complete tagged bird.
fixed_sample.no_outcomes: Do not compute or expose the unobserved abandoned old site in the destination month or any move-vs-stay benefit.

measures: median absolute error of each tag's two observed-site monthly indices
cross-tag Pearson correlation of 2N paired observed monthly index values
sign agreement of within-tag source/new monthly differences for birds with |source monthly difference| >=0.10
acceptance.threshold: At least 10 independent tagged birds with BOTH observed-month Landsat/source index pairs, median per-tag MAE <=0.20, pooled Pearson r >=0.60, and >=65% sign agreement among tags whose source between-month |delta| >=0.10 if at least 8 such tags exist; if fewer than 8, calibration status INSUFFICIENT_TEMPORAL_SIGNAL rather than PASS.
acceptance.bootstrap: 10000 tag-level bootstrap replicates for MAE and correlation descriptive intervals; optional if source signatures pass; no hypothesis p-values.
acceptance.reject_on_fail: STOP_LANDSAT_SOURCE_MEASUREMENT_NOT_COMPARABLE; no old-vs-new habitat-state benefit is calculated or publicized even when source scene metadata and QA pass.

validity.bias: Same GPS observations partly define core patch; calibration at core center may be noisy across a 250m patch and one satellite pixel.
validity.temporal: Published USGS index is a same-month GEE Landsat8/Sentinel2 composite; independent Landsat-only monthly median is NOT an identical product.
validity.scene_selection: All QA-valid scenes within month rather than picking best fit to source. Scene quality and DN rules fixed independently of source MNDWI values.
validity.source_confidentiality: Do not commit per-bird IDs, GPS coordinates, per-point MNDWI or signed SAS URLs; aggregate species not available.
validity.hard_boundary: Even PASS allows only measurement comparability. Geographic movement causing adaptive water-environment regulation remains unproven.
